cases.name: Autumn Marie Hagger
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Autumn attended Fennville Middle School where she was active as part of the cheer team, a percussion player in the school band. She played softball and loved riding horses. Autumn would have celebrated her 14th Birthday on Tuesday; January 10 and she was so excited to be turning 14 and learning how to drive. She loved with her whole heart and gave the biggest hugs. She wanted to be a dermatologist so that she could help people build confidence within themselves. Autumn was just learning how to draw and loved drawing mushrooms because you could color them and make them beautiful. She loved watching scary movies, sitting close and holding hands. A small girl with a big heart will be forever missed and loved by those who knew her."

cases.name: Cindy Nicole Clouse
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Cindy was a shining light, a great mom to her daughters Autumn and Mackenzie. She was the cool aunt, always dancing and making videos with her girls. Cindy worked at Appleton North Living Center in Holland, Michigan. She fell in love with the people she served. Cindy loved with her whole heart and would help anyone in need. She loved her chickens, 2 goats, pig and dogs. Known as the goofball in the family everyone looked forward to seeing Cindy and the girls pull up in the driveway. Her sudden passing has left her family and friends heartbroken; life will never be the same."

cases.name: Mackenzie Grace Hagger
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Mackenzie attended Fennville Elementary School in Fennville Michigan, she loved singing, swimming, softball and cheer. Mackenzie was the girly girl of the family, who loved makeup, and wanted her hair to be stylish and cute. She loved babies and wanted to have a big family. She was the favorite among her younger cousins. Mackenzie would send nightly text messages to say I love you and good night to her family and cousins. She wanted to be a Police officer and have a Police Dog. Sunflowers were her favorite flower and she asked for Sunflower décor for Christmas to put in her bedroom. We will never forget her loving heart and spirit."
